grammar reminder

2 people 👥 → than
Tyler is louder than Alex.
Leo is more creative than Bobby.
3+ people 👥👥 → the
Tyler is the loudest boy in the school.
Mandy is the most hard-working.
short: loud → louder → the loudest  ·  -y: funny → funnier → the funniest  ·  long: creative → more creative → the most creative  ·  ⚠️ good → better → the best · bad → worse → the worst
